why.title: Why Choose Polyglot Academy?
why.flexibleText: Our language courses are officially accredited by the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sports of the Republic of Armenia, allowing students to receive a tuition fee reimbursement of up to 100,000 AMD. The educational programs are built on a clear methodology that aligns with international standards.
why.certificationText: Teaching based on the Cambridge methodology ensures a structured, measurable, and internationally standardized learning process. This approach provides consistent development—from vocabulary and grammar to speaking, listening, reading, and writing—delivering comprehensive and systematic knowledge rather than fragmented skills
why.programsText: We prioritize continuous communication and student progress throughout the learning journey. In addition to direct interaction with specialised instructors, qualified mentors are actively involved and available to support students at every stage. Upon completing the course, graduates gain access to an exclusive community where we regularly share content designed to support long-term language retention and development.
why.formatsText: We offer training suitable for all language levels and age groups, delivered through online group classes, private individual sessions, and intensive formats. In the latter two formats, the learning schedule is fully managed by the student, offering maximum flexibility.
why.partnershipsText: We collaborate with industry-leading companies to build sustainable partnerships that benefit both the organizations and our students. These collaborations create valuable opportunities for professional growth and specialized training.

social.title: Social Responsibility
social.title2: Polyglot Academy is led by individuals with a strong sense of social responsibility—we are always ready to provide our support where it is needed most.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I check my language level?
faq.a1: The built-in test within our AI assistant allows you to accurately assess your language level. Based on your results, the system will recommend the most appropriate course for your needs.
faq.q2: In what formats are the classes conducted?
faq.a2: Classes are conducted through online group sessions, private individual lessons, and accelerated or intensive formats.
faq.q3: How long does the course last?
faq.a3: The course lasts four months, totaling 32 academic hours. The first 24 hours are dedicated to developing general language skills, followed by 8 hours focused exclusively on speaking skills, which are conducted based on the student’s preference.
faq.q4: What is included in the curriculum?
faq.a4: Video recordings of lessons, learning materials, mentor support, and progress tracking.
faq.q5: What happens if I miss a class?
faq.a5: Materials and recordings of missed classes are provided. In the individual format, scheduling is managed by the student; however, in case of three repeated absences, the learning process is suspended.

learn.q: What will I learn in this course?
learn.a: During the course, you will develop speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills, expand your vocabulary, apply grammar in real-life communication, and start speaking confidently on a variety of topics.

progress_check.a: Your progress is monitored through regular assessments, homework assignments, speaking exercises, and personalized feedback from your mentor.

no_progress.q: What happens if I don’t make progress?
no_progress.a: Each student’s progress is continuously monitored. If necessary, the program is adapted, and additional support and guidance are provided to help achieve the desired results.

result.q: What will I receive at the end of the course?
result.a: By the end of the course, you will have a solid language level, increased confidence in speaking, practical communication skills, and, of course, a certificate approved by the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sports of the Republic of Armenia.
